# no-undefined-outline-variables

Disallow Scenario Outline placeholders without a matching Examples column.

| Category | Recommended | Safe autofix | Default options |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| correctness | yes | no | none |

Finds step placeholders without an Examples column.

## Configuration

```json
{ "rules": { "no-undefined-outline-variables": "error" } }
```

## Triggered by

```text
Scenario Outline: lookup
  Given <missing> exists
  Examples:
    | id |
```
